title: Full-weight threshold for generic power-map S-boxes
summary: The cubic case has a proven minimal threshold for full weight, while the corresponding threshold and minimality result for a generic exponent remain conjectural.

formal_statement.body: For an encryption polynomial $E_k$ using the power-map S-box $S(x)=x^\alpha$, determine a round threshold after which $E_k$ has full weight $p^t$—meaning that all $p^t$ monomials occur—and prove that this threshold is minimal. For the cubic case $\alpha=3$, all monomials occur after $\lceil\log_3(p-1)\rceil+\lceil\log_3(t)\rceil$ rounds, and this number of rounds is minimal; the unresolved task is to establish the corresponding result for generic $\alpha$.

scope.domain: Algebraic structure of encryption polynomials induced by power-map S-boxes in substitution-permutation networks.
parameters: α: exponent of the power-map S-box
p and t: parameters governing the full weight p^t and the cubic round threshold
number of rounds: threshold being determined
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish the corresponding full-weight round threshold for generic α and prove that it is minimal.

citations.label: On a Generalization of Substitution-Permutation Networks: The HADES Design Strategy

progress.summary: The source presents a lemma establishing the full-weight threshold and its minimality for the cubic S-box. It then explicitly conjectures that a similar result holds for the generic power map.
citation_labels: Lorenzo Grassi et al., On a Generalization of Substitution-Permutation Networks: The HADES Design Strategy
